worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.summary: The plainest full-body tackle: charge in a straight line, hurl the target and be thrown back yourself, paying a moderate recoil. A whiff just skids to a stop.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.description: A straight-line charge that stops on the first target it hits: the tackle deals %1$s contact damage, charging up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius. A whiff or a blocked charge just skids to a stop with no self-damage.
On a hit the target is hurled %2$s blocks along the charge, and the user takes %1$s× the actual damage as recoil and slides %3$s blocks back; both displacements can be blocked along the way.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.brace.on: Braced form: the user plants itself and hurls the target further, but the tackle is a little weaker and shorter, it takes heavier recoil, and its wind-up and recovery are slower.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.brace.off: Driving form: both fighters are thrown apart, the slide sheds part of the recoil, and the rhythm is faster.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.growth.0: From level %1$s the tackle power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.growth.1: From level %1$s the tackle power rises to %2$s and the recoil fraction to %3$s×.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.use.1: Hurl a target off an ally or off a ledge
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.use.2: Trade for a solid contact blow when survival is not in question
On: the user plants itself and hurls the target further, but the tackle is a little weaker and shorter, it takes heavier recoil, and its wind-up and recovery are slower - good for shoving a target off an ally or a ledge. Off (driving form): both are thrown apart, the slide sheds part of the recoil, and the rhythm is faster.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts tackles sooner, and is easier to whiff.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting tackles (it still charges in when the target is below about 35%% health). Higher is more protective, and grabs fewer kills.
